rpcLimits.mevblocker: 10,000 blocks per eth_getLogs, 10,000 results, historical eth_call works
rpcLimits.publicnode: historical logs require a paid token

method.anchor: most recent block B with balanceOf(wallet) == 0, via archive eth_call
method.ledger: sum(Transfer to wallet) - sum(Transfer from wallet) on the aToken over [B, latest]
method.naive: sum(Supply) - sum(Withdraw) for the wallet over the same span
method.guard: ledgerDelta must equal balanceOfNow, so a wrong anchor fails loudly
whyNaiveFails: aTokens are transferable, so a position moves without emitting any Aave event
burns are not 1:1 with Withdraw: liquidations and repayWithATokens reduce aToken balance with no Withdraw event
